about.heading: About the Platform
about.description: This platform collects daily feedback from teachers and students to improve teaching quality and learning outcomes in government schools.

teachers.heading: For Teachers
teachers.description: Log in to provide daily feedback on class timings, topics covered, and interact with student feedback reports.

students.heading: For Students
students.description: Submit your daily feedback, answer quizzes, and help us evaluate teaching quality.

admins.heading: For Administrators
admins.description: Monitor feedback data, generate performance reports, and manage school feedback systems.
